snippet.title: Cowboy Bebop: Serenade Of Reminiscence (PS2 - JP Exclusive) |Longplay - Walkthrough| No Commentary
snippet.description:
Welcome to my - Longplay - Walkthrough - Gameplay - video of Cowboy Bebop: Serenade of Reminiscence on Playstation 2 with no commentary. The Japanese exclusive game title.

You can support my channel here:
► SUBSCRIBE: https://www.youtube.com/c/NoirStation
► TWITTER: https://twitter.com/The_NoirStation
► Leave a tip using Super Thanks!

Cowboy Bebop: Serenade Of Reminiscence (Also known as Cowboy Bebop: Tsuioku No Serenade) is an action, adventure, beat 'em up video game. Developed by Chime and published by Bandai in 2005. The Bebob's crew gets pulled into a series of unfortunate events surrounding a space pirate treasure, some mysterious song called - Diamonds. While at the same time some underground organisation is attacking them and seeking to find these treasures themselves.

NoirStation Rating: - 3 Out Of 5 - To be honest, in my opinion the western audiences have not missed out much with this one. The game is average at best and only appeals to the hardcore Cowboy Bebop fans. It has annoying unskippable cutscenes that take most of the gameplay, to the point that you could make another season for the show. Some other flaws as well, like bad controls, lack of replay value. However, the game tries to compensate with extra content after you beat the game.

Video Chapters:
Chapter 1 - Aquara - 00:00:00
Chapter 2 - Dome Town - 00:19:34
Chapter 3 - Kung Fu Street - 00:42:54
Chapter 4 - Oolong Town - 01:01:18
Chapter 5 - Oolong Town 2 - 01:31:58
Chapter 6 - Oolong Town Pier - 02:16:10
Chapter 7 - Treasure Island - 03:04:33
Chapter 8 - Church - 03:29:26
Chapter 9 - Battleship - 03:58:24

This video is recorded, played in my style, and edited by me. Longplay is made as fluid as possible without any deaths, unnecessary menus, loading screens, stumbling around or other non-essential things to a walkthrough. So that the video can be used as an easy to follow guide for educational, preservational or entertainment purposes. Review and description is written by me as well.
